verdict.rationale: Ardent is a database-branching service rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents agent integration only through the CLI, an ardent-cli skill and a REST API. Nothing describes an official MCP server or endpoint, and the CLI, skill and API are adjacent features that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
